step1.title: The people around you are waiting
step1.description: JChat connects you with everyone physically at the same place. Walk in, join the conversation.

step2.title: See what’s happening right now
step2.description: The map shows every active venue near you. The hotter the color, the more people inside.

step3.title: Chat, order, and connect
step3.description: Talk to everyone in the room, call for service, or order directly from the menu — all without leaving the conversation.

step4.title: You’re all set
step4.description: Find a place near you, walk in, and start connecting. Your next great night out starts here.
